messages.subject: missing geom_line
parts:
Hey all

I'm missing something fundamental about geom_line. I'm truing to plot
a line between a discrete x variable

library(ggplot2)

Ed<-data.frame(x.1 = c(1,2,3),
y.1 = c(8, 9.5, 2))

print(ggplot(Ed, aes(x = as.factor(x.1), y = y.1)) +
geom_line() +
scale_x_discrete() +
scale_y_continuous())

but this just results in a blank geom. What am I missing?

Thanks

Tom

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: missing geom_line
parts:
The goup asthetic is set to the interaction of all factors in the
plot. You need to override this using aes(goup= )

For example;
